title: Common vowel patterns: ee

steps.label: Listen
steps.instruction: An adult models the pattern ee in seed. Discuss accent differences where relevant.

steps.label: Blend
steps.instruction: Read seed, feet, green together. Use sounds modelled by the teacher rather than deriving phonemes from letter count.

steps.label: Practice
steps.instruction: Find the written pattern ee and read the word aloud.

steps.label: Apply
steps.instruction: Use one example word in a spoken sentence, then stop or repeat according to comfort.

quiz.prompt: Which written word contains the pattern “ee”?

teacher_note: These are new illustrative lesson plans, not the original Sahitya curriculum. Word pronunciation and pattern choice require local teacher review.
